description:
This week on The Rewind, Jack, Darren, and Marty chat about Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey. We'll go over non-spoiler impressions, take a look at the wider picture for Nolan/the box office/awards season, and then go full spoilers on the movie event of the summer.
